description: The bar chart illustrates the negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between the baseline Mistral-v0.2 model and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The x-axis represents per-specialty terms, including Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The y-axis measures the negative log-probability, ranging from -22 to -27. Each bar represents a different clinical specialty, with the baseline Mistral-v0.2 model shown in blue and the fine-tuned models shown in various shades of brown. The bars are grouped by specialty, with each color representing a different fine-tuning dataset. The chart shows that the negative log-probability varies across specialties, with some specialties having higher probabilities than others. The chart does not provide specific values for each bar, but the visual representation indicates the relative differences in probabilities between the baseline and fine-tuned models for each specialty.
